prompt: Two seasons after Demar Derozan was traded to the San Antonio Spurs, who was the leading scorer for the fifth place team in the Western Conference?
answer: Two seasons after DeMar DeRozan was traded to the Spurs—during the **2019–20 season**—the fifth-place Western Conference team was the **Oklahoma City Thunder**. Their leading scorer was **Danilo Gallinari**, averaging about **19.2 points per game**.
